name: Artemis III: Mons Mouton Plateau
note: Artemis III candidate region (16.0 km box). Point = best-lit spot with slope <= 8° found by our search: 71.9% average illumination at 2 m, slope 3.7°; the box centre gets 20.32%. LGRS box is named 'Leibnitz Beta Plateau' (Leibnitz Beta was renamed Mons Mouton); assumed to match NASA's 'Mons Mouton Plateau' region (unverified).
